text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup,
in which Almond Eye will be running.

I had come to watch the race on-site
alongside Lucky Lilac.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Keep your eyes open. If you wanna take on Ai-san,
you can't just ignore this Japan Cup.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Still... why's my heart churnin' up so much, despite all that...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Are ya scared...?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What I might end up finding out
in this race is—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—This year's "Japan Cup" is once again
a truly magnificent race,
bringing together many GⅠ Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of all this, the Umamusume drawing
the most attention has to be her—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Having brought immense excitement to this year's Tiara circuit, Almond Eye now enjoys idol-like popularity in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will that incredible late burst of speed
shine through even against
such a star-studded lineup?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, all runners are entering the gates.
We are moments away from the start—
And so, the Japan Cup got underway—
History is changing.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —This is Kiseki's!! Winning paneeeeel!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead is number 8, Kiseki!!
Charging up the slope!! Can he pull off the wire-to-wire win?!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I am the one――――――who will win!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye dodges! She dodges!!
She pulls cleeeaaar!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—She wins, she wins!!
It's Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A truly terrifying Umamusume:
Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (Ooooooohhhhh!?!?)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Incredible, it's a record time!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She blasted across the line with an unbelievable time!!
Who could have ever imagined such a time being clocked?!
...I stand in stunned silence. The displayed time beats every 2400m turf record the URA has ever logged.

And what is even more terrifying is that this time
even shatters the world record for 2400 meters on turf.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I win!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!)
Today, Almond Eye ran 2,400 meters faster than anyone in the world, etching her name into legend—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A victory by a Classic-year Tiara Umamusume—a historic feat second only to Gentildonna!!
Just how far will this Umamusume's strength go...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ya gotta be kiddin' me...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Ai-san's running today... was completely different from the Shuka Sho...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Speed, stamina, timing the push, pace control—everything...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (In other words... she's grown that much—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I'm heading home first—

I managed to catch up to Lucky Lilac,
who had quickly walked away from the stands.

"Today's race might have been
a bit too shocking for her..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Mind if we change locations?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Right now... I just didn't want to be at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...That race just now.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
how did you feel watching Ai-san run?
choice_data_list: ...To be honest, it was terrifying even.

text_block_list.text:
My candid thought was the sheer depth of her potential.
Watching her past battles against Lucky Lilac, I knew she was no ordinary Umamusume.
However, today's run packed a shock that completely overturned everything I thought I knew about Almond Eye...
choice_data_list: Just how strong are you planning to get?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Haha...—no, but seriously—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...You're absolutely right.
...Give me a break, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Until now, I've pretended not to notice.
But today, it has been made painfully clear to me."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"There are no limits to Ai-san's growth.
...And I've realized that I do have limits."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"With every leg of the Triple Tiara,
I have steadily grown stronger."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
To win... to bloom in full glory...
To make sure no one ever catches up to me...
Every single time, giving it my all—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And yet, driven solely by that desire to "win,"
Ai-san kept growing stronger at a terrifying speed...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No matter how confident I was going in,
she never faltered. Her eyes would just sparkle, saying, "I'm going to win"—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Regarding the Shuka Sho the other day.
There was something I felt after crossing the finish line."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The chilling sensation that told me,
'I've just hit my absolute limit'...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I can't picture advancing into the realm beyond.
Even if I could, it feels like there's almost no room left... A sense of suffocation.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And yet, in the Japan Cup,
Ai-san showed that she had grown dramatically stronger
than she was during the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Up until the Shuka Sho, we were in a state where
anyone could have won or lost, but...
that era has completely come to an end."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I finally get it now.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "So this is the end of the line," I thought.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to you, Trainer,
I was able to keep running all the way until today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The title of Junior Class Queen...
and my record in the Classic Class...
I take pride in all of it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: With this pride in my heart, I will...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: From here on, I'll run within my means.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I will gladly concede the true center stage to Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If it's her, she'll definitely achieve even greater feats
and reach unimaginable heights
in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I will... bloom at the heights I can reach, stand where I belong, and shine brightly without fail.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: Is that the star role you were aiming for?
Is that the star role you were aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I just don't have the confidence.
And deep down, that's already what I've
come to believe about myself.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Forget it already," they say.
"You can shine bright enough right here," they say. ...That's why—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I look forward to your continued guidance and mentorship
starting tomorrow as well.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Well then, shall we head back?

...As she began walking away,
I had no idea what words I should say to her.
And yet—
choice_data_list: (...No matter how hard I tried, I just couldn't see it.)
(...No matter how hard I tried, I just couldn't see it.)

text_block_list.text: When I asked, "Is that the stardom you were aiming for?", a pause fell between us. There were moments in the days spent with her where I felt something very similar to this.
That exact moment is when she hears a silly joke and plays the straight man in her head.

Therefore, to me, she didn't look like she truly meant
"I'm done with this." Rather, she looked like she
still had some rebellious fire left in her.
choice_data_list: (Still, I couldn't bring myself to point it out...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: “...I don't have any confidence.”

...Right now, after seeing Almond Eye's terrifying competitive spirit
and the overwhelming results it brought,
she has lost all her confidence.

Yet if she can regain that confidence,
she might be able to strive once more toward the star she dreams of becoming...!

What should I do to help Lucky Lilac
regain her confidence?
After turning over various ideas, one comes to mind.

If she cannot believe in herself,
how about letting someone else give her that confidence?

And so, I went to see Orfevre to ask
if she could offer some words of encouragement
to Lucky Lilac.
I thought that words from someone she admired might help Lucky Lilac regain her confidence in bantering, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――Get lost.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You dare rob me of my time with such trifles?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Be grateful that you weren't sent flying with a kick.

"The intimidating aura radiating from Orfevre
makes my hair stand on end. An urge to flee this place right now
wells up, but I grit my teeth and hold my ground."
choice_data_list: Lend me your strength. She really looks up to you...!
Please lend me your strength. She admires you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Just because I looked up to them, so what?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
One who can only define themselves through others
has no right to stand at the pinnacle to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...A "King" is different.
The "King" decides for herself that she is "King."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Even if dark clouds loom and my crown be soiled,
I shall show the heavens that I alone am King, and overturn it all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It is toward that radiance that the longing of the common people naturally gathers.
Engrave that into your very being.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...There won't be a next time.
Begone at once.
choice_data_list: ...All right. Sorry for taking up your time.
...All right. I'm sorry for taking up your time.

text_block_list.text:
...After finishing my audience with Orfevre, I reflected.
She completely dismissed my request, but—
choice_data_list: (...Maybe I got a hint after all.)

text_block_list.text:
"That Orfevre is a legendary presence
in racing history is an indisputable fact.
However—"

Even she was not entirely invincible.
Along the path of her hoofprints,
a few defeats certainly existed.

And yet, she radiates a brilliance so immense for posterity
that it renders such matters trivial.
...Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"'...A "king" is different.
A "king" defines oneself as "king".'"

Those words were likely the very core
of how she overcame defeat and hardship.

Orfevre took her conviction of being "King"
as supreme confidence, blazing her trail of conquest.

It wasn't given to me by anyone else.
It's the "ideal self" I decided for myself――

"Having conviction toward that is the driving force behind great feats.
...That is how I interpreted Orfevre's words."

If Lucky Lilac had an "ideal self"
like that too, maybe she could deliver
her tsukkomi with confidence.
And that "ideal self" was none other than—

...Let us awaken it once more.
Her sense of self as a "Queen." Her confidence.
"To that end, I... made up my mind to play the unwanted fool—"
